timeline.title: A Short History of Home Sweet Home
items: Long ago
A warm welcome
The story goes that guests brought firewood to a new home to light every hearth. Hence: housewarming.
A home is a castle
An English court declared that a person's house is their castle, a safe place that is theirs alone.
Home! Sweet Home!
A song gave the world the line: be it ever so humble, there's no place like home. It became a hit.
No place like home
Dorothy clicked her ruby slippers in The Wizard of Oz, and a whole world agreed with her.
today: Keys in hand, boxes everywhere and a brand new chapter. The best one yet.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Home
items: Where we love is home, home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
The ache for home lives in all of us.
Maya Angelou
Home is where the heart is.
An old saying
East or west, home is best.
An old proverb
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. We just say: welcome home, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of Feeling at Home
items: home
A map in your head
The brain has place cells that map where you are. Their discovery won a Nobel Prize in 2014.
leaf
Home smells like you
Most people cannot smell their own home. The brain gets used to familiar scents and tunes them out.
moon
The first night
In a new place, part of the brain stays a little more alert on night one. It is called the first night effect.
key
Why did I come in here?
Walking through a doorway can make you forget what you came for. Scientists call it the doorway effect.
sun
Sunny rooms
Morning light helps set the body clock, which is one reason a bright room feels so good.
heart
You did it anyway
Moving house is often ranked among life's most stressful events. And look at you now.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It cannot explain why your own sofa is the comfiest in the world.

note.title: What we believe a home is
note.contents: A note for your new home
paras: Some magazines make us put the kettle on and smile. This was one of them.
We believe a home is not the walls or the postcode. It is the mug by the sink, the shoes by the door, the light you can see from the street that means someone is in.
{who}, someone wanted to mark this moment properly. Not a card that gets lost in a box, but pages full of you, your new front door and the life you will build behind it.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, this home is going to be full of love.
note.wish: Welcome home, {who}. May every day here be a happy one.
